policy.selection_inputs: only train RGB SAM3-base patch_mean and raw tokens; no GT, pseudo masks, conditioned features, val/test features or metrics
policy.local_features: 64 visual token clusters learned from 64 spatially uniform tokens/image; Hellinger histogram, train-only IDF
policy.objective: greedy maximize mean nearest-selected similarity; stable id tie-break
policy.duplicates: exact image-file SHA256 duplicates excluded from candidate set; no manual exclusion
policy.mask_access: only after all selections and stopping results frozen; export selected GT for post-selection audit
policy.automatic_stop: exploratory: gain/initial_single_anchor_distortion <0.01 for three consecutive additions, range4..64; no claim this ensures segmentation saturation
